correct_completion: I want to order a big pizza.
full_sentence: I am very hungry, so I want to order a big pizza.
acceptable_variants: I would like a big pizza.

options.why_wrong: This is an unrelated fact about the restaurant. It is not a result of being hungry, so it does not complete the cause and effect set by 'so'.

options.text: I want to order a big pizza.
I am not hungry at all.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts the stem, which says the speaker is very hungry. 'So' needs a result that follows from the first part.

options.text: the waiter gave me the bill.
options.why_wrong: This happens after a meal, so it cannot be a result of being hungry before ordering.

explanation: 'So' introduces a result that follows from the first clause. Being very hungry leads to wanting to order food, so the second part must describe a logical action that comes next when someone wants to eat. Polish speakers may place the result clause after the connector in the same way, which helps with this pattern.
translation: Jestem bardzo głodny, więc chcę zamówić dużą pizzę.
